Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class DryGasSealVentStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.DryGasSealVentStudy
public final class DryGasSealVentStudy extends Object
Steady, rated-capacity vent study for one tandem compressor seal end. Solves both cavity pressures and interstage transfer from net incoming loads and installed pressure/flow tables. Each set of tables applies to one gas, temperature, receiving pressure and equipment condition. No extrapolation or implicit protection action is credited.

  • Constructor Details

    • DryGasSealVentStudy

      public DryGasSealVentStudy(DryGasSealVentStudy.Vent primary, DryGasSealVentStudy.Vent secondary, double[] transferKgS, double[] differentialBar)
      Constructs one hydraulic configuration. Use signed reverse data when reverse interstage transfer is credible.
      Parameters:
      primary - primary vent to flare, with a single outlet
      secondary - secondary vent, optionally including a bearing-side path
      transferKgS - increasing signed interstage flow, positive from primary to secondary
      differentialBar - increasing signed primary minus secondary pressure at each flow, including (0,0). Supply only (0,0) for a gas-tight stage.

  • Method Details

    • evaluate

      public DryGasSealVentStudy.Result evaluate(double sourceBara, double processLeakKgS, double primaryPurgeKgS, double secondaryPurgeKgS)
      Calculates one operating or failure case. The leakage load is specified at the study conditions. Supply values are the parts entering each cavity after other splits, not total panel flows.
      Parameters:
      sourceBara - available pressure upstream of the primary face in bara
      processLeakKgS - process-origin gas entering the primary cavity in kg/s
      primaryPurgeKgS - non-process gas entering the primary cavity in kg/s
      secondaryPurgeKgS - non-process gas entering the secondary cavity in kg/s
      Returns:
      steady pressures, branch rates and process-origin gas rates
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when the rated network cannot resolve a physical steady state

    • solveTransfer

      private double solveTransfer(double low, double high, double primaryLoad, double secondaryLoad)
      Solves the monotone interstage pressure balance within the intersection of all three rated flow ranges.
      Parameters:
      low - minimum admissible transfer in kg/s
      high - maximum admissible transfer in kg/s
      primaryLoad - primary inflow in kg/s
      secondaryLoad - secondary inflow in kg/s
      Returns:
      pressure-balanced transfer in kg/s
